assign.outcome:
**The recommendations did not pass the gate — nothing was built on top.** `decl` precision is **0.17** (1 right of 6 proposed), well under the 0.6 bar the brief set, so step 5 (the preview mechanism) was deliberately not built.

**And consensus inverts.** Findings three seats agreed on are **0.33** right; findings a lone seat raised are **0.66**. Zero contradictory directions — the failure Mike feared did not happen. A different one did: the seats agree on generic complaints (dead space right, pale grey, unframed cards) that are deliberate design here, while the real bugs were each caught by exactly one seat — a progress bar filled 1-of-5 beside a `0/5` label, a subtitle promising *five* above **ACTIVE 4**, every card description truncated. Both Sonnet seats made the *same* false pixel claim, so agreement is partly shared bias.
